newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nepal buys gas oil from BP, kerosene from Mobil.
newsitem.headline: Nepal buys gas oil from BP, kerosene from Mobil.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) has awarded its gas oil import tender for November arrival to British Petroleum and superior kerosene to Mobil Singapore, an NOC source said on Tuesday.

He said the 30,000 tonnes of 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil were purchased around $232.80 per tonne for November 5-11 delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Paradeep or Haldia on India's east coast.
The 30,000 tonnes of kerosene were bought at $249.50 per tonne for November 15-25 delivery, c-and-f Madras or Haldia.
The tender, which closed on October 12, attracted around 13 offers.
Nepal cancelled its previous tender to buy kerosene for October 1-15 delivery. The best offer in that tender was made by Kuwaiti-based IPG at $245 per tonne, c-and-f.
